native_score_levels: 0-based; UI maps expected score to 1..5 by +1

kind.instructions: Classify target_asset from the supplied evidence. This is an editorial content kind, not a codec. If evidence is inadequate use other and mark information_sufficient low.

criteria.footage: Real-world moving imagery without a dominant interview, screen, slide, or graphics format.
criteria.screen_recording: A captured software interface, desktop, or device screen is the main content.
criteria.talking_head: A visible speaker addressing the viewer or interviewer dominates the asset.
criteria.slideshow: Mostly discrete presentation slides with little live-camera movement.
criteria.motion_graphics: Designed animation, kinetic typography, or graphic elements dominate.
criteria.photo_sequence: A sequence of still photographs is presented over time.
criteria.other: Audio-only, a standalone still, mixed formats without a dominant kind, or insufficient evidence.

usable.instructions: Rate technical edit usability of target_asset using measured blur, exposure, clipping, duration, audio, and coverage. Do not infer visual quality from transcript alone.
criteria: 1: Unusable for the intended edit; unreadable/corrupt or severe persistent loss of required picture/audio.
2: Major quality problems; usable only after substantial repair or in a very limited context.
3: Usable with visible/audible defects or partial coverage; review and ordinary cleanup required.
4: Good source quality; minor defects and no persistent loss of essential content.
5: Excellent source quality for this edit; relevant coverage and measurements support clean picture and required audio.

has_on_screen_text.instructions: Does target_asset contain readable on-screen text, supported by OCR or attached visual evidence? A skipped OCR stage is not negative evidence.

criteria.true: Readable text is observed in OCR or attached frames.
criteria.false: Adequate reviewed visual/OCR coverage supports no readable on-screen text.

has_speech.instructions: Does target_asset contain intelligible human speech, supported by local VAD/ASR evidence? Energy alone does not prove speech.

criteria.true: Intelligible speech is supported by local evidence.
criteria.false: Adequate local audio evidence supports no intelligible speech.

safety_review.instructions: Choose a coarse editorial review status from the evidence available for target_asset. Missing visual/audio coverage must use needs_review. This is not comprehensive moderation.

criteria.clean: Adequate reviewed evidence contains no configured coarse editorial concern.
criteria.needs_review: Evidence is missing, uncertain, sensitive, or plausibly contains a configured concern.
criteria.reject: Available evidence clearly meets an explicit configured editorial exclusion; never delete the asset automatically.

bin_suggestion.instructions: Suggest one primary editorial bin for target_asset and the supplied focus. Infer no unseen content.

criteria.broll: Supporting visual coverage rather than the main narrative.
criteria.aroll: Primary narrative, demonstration, or presenter material.
criteria.titles: Title cards, overlays, slides primarily useful for text/introduction.
criteria.music: Predominantly a music bed with no required spoken narrative.
criteria.sfx: Short nonverbal sound effects or ambience for supporting an edit.
criteria.unusable: Evidence supports technical unsuitability; uncertain material is reviewed, not automatically discarded.

information_sufficient.instructions: Is the supplied extraction and modality coverage sufficient for the asset judgments requested? Text paths in frame_manifest are not images.

criteria.true: Required measurements and modality evidence are available for the requested judgments.
criteria.false: Missing, failed, sparse, or conflicting evidence prevents a dependable judgment.

content_complete.instructions: Does the observed narrative begin and end as a self-contained thought for the supplied focus? A silent B-roll or music bed can be complete for its intended purpose.

criteria.true: The material has a usable beginning and ending for its editorial role.
criteria.false: It cuts off required context, speech, action, or resolution.

usable_broll.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support using target_asset as supplemental visual coverage for focus? No pixels means visual suitability may be unknown.

criteria.true: Actual visual evidence supports supplemental coverage relevant to focus.
criteria.false: Adequate visual evidence supports irrelevance or technical unsuitability.

shot.instructions: For state.target_scene only, classify the primary shot scale from attached frames and observed subject extent. Without adequate pixels choose unknown.

criteria.closeup: A face, object, or small detail fills much of the frame.
criteria.medium: A subject is shown at roughly waist/torso scale with some environment.
criteria.wide: Environment dominates or a whole subject is shown with substantial surroundings.
criteria.insert: A detail shot of an object or action that supports the narrative.
criteria.overhead: The camera looks mainly downward from above the subject or work surface.
criteria.unknown: No dependable pixels, ambiguous subject scale, or mixed framing.

motion.instructions: For state.target_scene only, use timestamped motion measurements and consecutive attached frames. cutty describes frequent edits; do not confuse one still with motion evidence.

criteria.static: Little camera movement after excluding subject-only movement.
criteria.handheld: Irregular camera shake or unstable framing dominates.
criteria.tracking: Coherent following, panning, tilting, or camera travel dominates.
criteria.cutty: Frequent shot changes dominate the supplied local scene group.

highlight_value.instructions: For target_scene and focus, rate editorial value using observed action, transcript, completeness, and technical usability. No promise of popularity.
criteria: 1: Irrelevant, unusable, or lacks the essential context for focus.
2: Weak supporting material, repetitive setup, or unresolved content.
3: Relevant and usable but routine; a possible supporting moment.
4: Clear, useful, engaging moment with enough context and a discernible point.
5: Strong self-contained payoff, insight, demonstration, or moment directly serving focus.

keep_in_rough_cut.instructions: Should target_scene be proposed for a human-reviewed rough cut given focus, repetition, completeness, and technical evidence?

criteria.true: Useful and sufficiently complete material merits proposing a keep.
criteria.false: Irrelevant, redundant, or clearly unsuitable material merits a drop proposal.

information_sufficient.instructions: Is evidence for target_scene adequate for the requested visual and editorial judgments?

criteria.true: Timestamped required visual/text/audio evidence exists.
criteria.false: Sparse frames, no text/audio, or failed extraction leaves relevant uncertainty.

content_complete.instructions: Is the target_scene narrative/action internally complete for focus?

criteria.true: The point or action is understandable without a missing lead-in or ending.
criteria.false: It starts mid-thought/action or omits necessary resolution.

caption_matches_frame.instructions: Do the supplied caption/OCR or ASR excerpts actually refer to the visible content at matching timestamps? Only evaluate if both text and pixels exist.

criteria.true: Matched timestamped text is consistent with visible content.
criteria.false: Matched timestamped text conflicts with visible content.

visually_salient.instructions: Does target_scene contain a visually distinct, useful moment for focus, based on actual attached frames?

criteria.true: An observed subject/action provides distinct visual value.
criteria.false: Adequate visual evidence shows no distinct value for this focus.

is_filler.instructions: For target_window only, is the observed text mainly nonessential disfluency, repetition, or setup relative to focus?

criteria.true: Mostly nonessential filler for this edit.
criteria.false: Substantive material or necessary context.

is_hook.instructions: For target_window only, does observed text provide a concrete opening reason to keep watching, without inventing a headline?

criteria.true: A relevant question, surprising fact, payoff preview, or clear stakes occurs.
criteria.false: No useful opening hook is present.

topic_label.instructions: For target_window only, choose one closed editorial topic-role label.

criteria.introduction: Sets context or introduces the main subject.
criteria.explanation: Explains a principle, cause, or procedure.
criteria.demonstration: Shows or walks through an example/action.
criteria.conclusion: Resolves, summarizes, or closes a point.
criteria.promotion: Primarily advertises or asks for a conversion.
criteria.off_topic: Material is unrelated to supplied focus.
criteria.other: None of the above or insufficient evidence.

keep.instructions: For target_window only, should this observed content be proposed for the rough cut?

criteria.true: Relevant and substantive content merits a keep proposal.
criteria.false: Unnecessary repetition, irrelevance, or unusable context merits a drop proposal.

chapter_boundary.instructions: At the start of target_window, does the observed text begin a new substantive topic compared with previous_window?

criteria.true: A topic transition is evidenced.
criteria.false: The same topic continues or context is insufficient.

structure_guess.instructions: Classify the observed clip sequence in target_project, using clip order, evidence coverage, and focus.

criteria.ad: Promotional sequence with a conversion goal.
criteria.documentary_short: A factual narrative combining contextual coverage or interviews.
criteria.raw_dump: No dependable structure or insufficient sequencing evidence.

needs_wide.instructions: Does target_project lack wide coverage needed for its declared focus and edit intent?

criteria.true: A needed establishing/wide view is absent.
criteria.false: Wide coverage is present or not needed.

needs_closeup.instructions: Does target_project lack closeup/detail coverage needed for its declared focus and edit intent?

criteria.true: A needed detail view is absent.
criteria.false: Closeup/detail coverage is present or not needed.

needs_broll.instructions: Does target_project lack supplemental B-roll needed for its declared focus and edit intent?

criteria.true: Needed supplemental coverage is absent.
criteria.false: Supporting footage is present or not needed.

needs_title.instructions: Does target_project lack a title/context card needed for its declared focus and audience?

criteria.true: A needed context/title element is absent.
criteria.false: Required context is already clear or a title is unnecessary.

has_opening_hook.instructions: Does the observed opening of target_project give a concrete reason to keep watching?

criteria.true: The opening establishes relevant stakes, question, or payoff.
criteria.false: No useful opening motivation is evidenced.

narrative_coherence.instructions: Rate coherence of the observed ordered clip sequence, accounting for intentional genre and missing evidence.
criteria: 1: Incoherent or essential context is absent.
2: Some relation among clips but major unexplained jumps.
4: Clear sequence with minor transitions to improve.
5: Strongly coherent sequence serving the stated focus.

information_sufficient.instructions: Is the supplied ordered clip evidence sufficient to assess project structure and coverage?

criteria.true: All relevant active clip ranges and expected modalities are represented.
criteria.false: Missing clips, failed extraction, or sparse evidence blocks judgment.

dispatch.scene_group: two scenes x 8 explicitly targeted questions = 16
dispatch.text_group: two 15-45s windows x 5 explicitly targeted questions = 10
dispatch.pixel_question_gate: Require actual attached pixels; frame paths alone never satisfy this gate.
